about: a cross-package feature: the plan must own the route wiring, cover authorization, and keep the user's definition of done verbatim
goal: Users can share a schedule via a public read-only link: POST /schedules/:id/share creates an opaque token for the schedule's owner, GET /share/:token returns the schedule read-only, and the web app gets a copy-link button.
done: I can create a link for my own schedule, open it while logged out and see the schedule read-only, and nobody else can create links for my schedules.
